videos.script: Lantern's customers have spent about three hundred and ninety-five reais each. Not one of them behaves like that. {{average}} This lesson splits the average three ways. {{three}} A segment splits customers by what they do now. Frequent, quiet, gone. {{segments}} A cohort splits them by when they started, and follows each generation as it ages. {{cohorts}} A funnel splits visits by how far they got on the way to a purchase. {{funnel}} Each one has a classic mistake, and each mistake produces a number that looks right. {{mistakes}} A rule that scores two identical customers differently. {{ties}} A month that has not happened yet, counted as a month when nobody came back. {{censoring}} You will make each mistake on Lantern's data, and then fix it. {{fix}} And along the way, you will answer the question lesson two left open. Did Black Friday's customers stay? {{stay}}
